title: Aspect in Future Tense
intro: Building on A2 future tense basics and B1 aspect lessons, we now contrast the two Russian futures in detail. IMPERFECTIVE future (буду + infinitive) describes ongoing, repeated, or process-focused future actions: Завтра я буду работать (Tomorrow I will be working). PERFECTIVE future (conjugated perfective verb) describes single completed future actions with a result: Завтра я напишу письмо (Tomorrow I will write the letter - and finish it). Choose imperfective for duration/process, perfective for result/completion.
rules: Imperfective future = буду/будешь/будет + impf infinitive: Я буду читать (I will be reading / I will read - process)
Perfective future = conjugated perfective verb: Я прочитаю (I will read and finish)
Duration/process → imperfective: Весь день буду работать (I'll work all day)
Single result/completion → perfective: Я позвоню тебе завтра (I'll call you tomorrow - one call)
examples: Что ты будешь делать завтра? — Буду отдыхать. (What will you do tomorrow? — I'll be resting.), process
Я прочитаю эту книгу за неделю. (I'll read this book in a week.), completion with result
Летом мы будем путешествовать. (In summer we'll be traveling.), extended activity
Он скоро придёт. (He'll come soon.), single arrival

items.prompt: Завтра весь день я _____ дома. (Tomorrow I'll be working at home all day.)
items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I'll be working at home all day.
items.explanation: Extended duration uses imperfective: буду работать.

items.prompt: Я _____ тебе, когда приеду. (I'll call you when I arrive.)
items.promptEnglish: I'll call you when I arrive.
items.explanation: Single call with result uses perfective: позвоню.

items.prompt: Что вы _____ на ужин? (What will you be having for dinner?)
items.promptEnglish: What will you be having for dinner?
items.explanation: General question about activity uses imperfective: будете есть.

items.prompt: Я _____ эту задачу до вечера. (I'll solve this problem by evening.)
items.promptEnglish: I'll solve this problem by evening.
items.explanation: Completed result by deadline uses perfective: решу.

items.prompt: Летом мы _____ на даче. (In summer we'll be living at the dacha.)
items.promptEnglish: In summer we'll be living at the dacha.
items.explanation: Extended living uses imperfective: будем жить.

items.prompt: Она _____ письмо и отправит его. (She'll write the letter and send it.)
items.promptEnglish: She'll write the letter and send it.
items.explanation: Completed action in sequence uses perfective: напишет.

items.prompt: — Ты _____ мне? — Да, обязательно помогу. (Will you help me? Yes, I'll definitely help.)
items.promptEnglish: Will you help me? - Yes, I'll definitely help.
items.explanation: Request for definite help uses perfective: поможешь.

items.prompt: Весь вечер мы _____ телевизор. (We'll be watching TV all evening.)
items.promptEnglish: We'll be watching TV all evening.
items.explanation: Extended activity uses imperfective: будем смотреть.

items.prompt: Завтра я _____ рано и пойду на работу. (Tomorrow I'll get up early and go to work.)
items.promptEnglish: Tomorrow I'll get up early and go to work.
items.explanation: Single completed action uses perfective: встану.

blanks: Я долго _____ над этим проектом. (I'll be working on this project for a long time.)
Завтра я весь день _____ книгу. (Tomorrow I'll be reading a book all day.)
Завтра она обязательно _____ это письмо. (Tomorrow she'll definitely finish this letter.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Duration (долго) requires imperfective future; definite result requires perfective
hints: 'Весь день' = all day, ongoing process — which future?
explanations: Duration requires imperfective future: буду работать.
All-day process requires imperfective future: буду читать.
Definite completed result uses perfective future: напишет.

minimalPairs.context: Завтра я _____ книгу. (reading as activity, duration unknown)
minimalPairs.explanation: Activity without specified completion uses imperfective: буду читать.

minimalPairs.context: Завтра я _____ эту книгу. (will finish it)
